answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 31997 Country: India Title: Me and my father are involved in export of frozen meat. Question: Me and my father are involved in export of frozen meat. Sometimes we have to show interest amount while paying taxes. Now just let me know if it is lawful for us to show because Alhamdulillah we ourselves abstain ourselves from getting or paying interest. Answer ID: 31997 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 842/532/L=1432) There is no harm only in showing the interest money, but it is haram to use the interest money. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
